ios.desc:
Take flight over the San Francisco Bay Area in Astra Jet, an immersive flight simulator for Apple Vision Pro.

Pilot an F-35A with natural head movements. Nod to pitch, tilt to roll, and look around as you soar past the Golden Gate Bridge, explore Stanford’s campus, or accelerate across the bay. Calibrate from a comfortable seated or reclined position, then adjust your speed and control sensitivity to suit your flying style.

  EXPLORE THE BAY AREA
  Choose departure points including San Francisco, Stanford, Palo Alto, San Jose, Oakland, Berkeley, Marin, Napa, and Sonoma. Discover a continuous landscape built with real aerial photography, terrain, and millions of building footprints.

  FLY YOUR WAY
  Cruise above the rooftops or push toward Mach 10. Perform loops and barrel rolls, skim the coastline, and recover with convenient pause, recenter, and level-flight controls.

  JUMP INTO AIR COMBAT
  Track enemy fighters and flying saucers, acquire a homing lock, and pinch to launch missiles. Spatial engine, launch, and explosion sounds bring the action around you.

  READY TO FLY OFFLINE
  All scenery is included. No account, map subscription, or internet connection is required for flight. Head and optional hand tracking are processed on your device.

  Requires Apple Vision Pro with visionOS 2.0 or later.
